candidate_disposition.candidate: EO11782 and EO12379, including source-ladder duplicate
candidate_disposition.disposition: Only exact Advisory Council body-name hits. Full original and revoker read; no independently added Council duties discovered by that query.

Material HEW/Department of Education office-succession context. Section1-101 expressly makes May4,1980 the Department of Education Organization Act effective date; section1-102 directs OMB implementation of its transfers. The EO does not itself set out HEW/HHS redesignation, allocation or savings text, nor revoke EO11782 or terminate its Council.

Material Bank-subject candidate read in full. It creates a distinct Postal Service Task Force, assigns Treasury/Bank chair responsibility, and directs the Bank to provide that Task Force support and funding. These independently sourced 2018 duties belong to the Bank and a different task force; they do not revive the 1974 Advisory Council or survive as residual commands of EO11782.

Exact treatment of the HEW roster reference remains a limited membership-history question; no statutory first-end is selected from the editorial note or Act effective-date EO alone.
assessment.original_commands_vs_added_duties: Original Council advice, coordination and Treasury support remain separate from exact membership wording and from later Bank duties for the Postal Service Task Force. No date from office succession or another task force is mechanically applied to these original commands.
